# What does my Gift Aid donation really cost me?

> Free UK Gift Aid calculator for higher and additional rate taxpayers: what the charity receives, the relief you reclaim, the carry-back to last tax year, and the gift that wins back your personal allowance. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
